# Plugins

Opt-in per-domain **tool plugins** register through the public `starboard.mcp_tools` entry-point group and are discovered at runtime. With no plugins installed, discovery returns an empty catalog and every built-in tool keeps working.

[← Capability Catalog](../CATALOG.md)

| Aspect | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Entry-point group | `starboard.mcp_tools` |
| Contract | `starboard.tools.plugins.ToolPlugin` |
| Reference package | `starboard-plugin-sample` |

**Contract:** each entry-point value resolves to a `ToolPlugin` object; discovery loads it and registers its tools into a `ToolCatalog` keyed by the plugin's `name`. Copy `packages/starboard-plugin-sample/` as the starting point for a real per-domain plugin.
